notes: C-0001 resolved as witness A-attribution-W01: the SSRC working paper is the arXiv 2508.00838 preprint by Strauss, Yang, O'Reilly, Rosenblat and Moure, dated 2025-06-27 on arXiv and on its Rogue Scholar DOI record, later published in Data & Policy 8, e15 (online 2026-04-28, DOI 10.1017/dap.2026.10064). It precedes every claim it bears on and is an anticipation. C-0002 resolved as witness A-attribution-W02: arXiv 2510.04226 v1, 2025-10-05, by Wright, Masud, Moore, Yadav, Antoniak, Christensen, Park and Augenstein. It measures epistemic diversity and has no bearing on attribution; it is recorded against two B-collapse claims (PRED-199.A1, as a mechanism-level disconfirmation in another domain; PRED-857.F1, as the method carried out). The main session should check that placement against the B-collapse reader's file to avoid a duplicate. Class-level exclusion: the query-resolution forecasts (PRED-140.A1, PRED-141.A1 to A5, PRED-768.A1 to A5) forecast what a query will surface about the archive's own terms. Outside research on source bias bears only on their premise, so none was attached; their test is the archive's own capture. The same holds for the claims about the archive's own entities and deposits (Lee Sharks, Mary Lee, Pearl, the MacArthur bios, the Dodecad and similar), which no outside study can witness. A-attribution-W12 (BuzzStream) is the one disconfirmation in theme A: it breaks the first link of PRED-615.B3. The same post would support a component of PRED-1091.B3 (the platform's opt-out does not control use); it was not attached there because a witness carries one direction, and the main session may add a second link as its own witness if wanted. Several witnesses are industry or vendor studies (Ahrefs, BuzzStream, SE Ranking via SEJ, Chartbeat via SEJ); their class is recorded as post or news, and their vendor status is listed under unverified. Two primaries were refused or gated (bbc.com blocked; Chartbeat report gated; SE Ranking page empty); the witnesses rest on the copies named in checked. Quotes are as returned by WebFetch, which quotes in segments of under 125 characters; quotes the tool gave only in paraphrase were left out. No memory facts were used in this pass.
